profile.org_note: SB Holding Corp. d/b/a Signature Homes is wholly employee-owned through the Signature Homes Employee Stock Ownership Plan (effective 2016-01-01), run from Hoover, AL with a Birmingham operation and a Nashville office (Franklin, TN). Chairman and co-founder Dwight Sandlin is the public decision-maker; third-party directories (not the company) show President Daryl Spears (former CFO) and CFO Jacob Hall reporting to him, and co-founder Jonathan Belcher fronted the 2025 Riverwalk land purchase. No land acquisition or development executive is published.
profile.summary: The ranked company is the Hoover/Birmingham, Alabama Signature Homes (founders Dwight Sandlin and Jonathan Belcher), not the Pleasanton, CA builder: Pro Builder's 2026 Top 200 lists 'Signature Homes*' at rank 65 with website signature.homes, $426.3M revenue and 528 closings, the same 528 closings and $426M that Builder's 2026 Builder 100 shows at rank 99, and Builder's firm page gives Suite E-4, 3545 Market St., Hoover, AL with CEO Dwight Sandlin. It is a private, full-ESOP, move-up and active-adult builder (about $800K average price) in Birmingham/Hoover and the Nashville suburbs, founded 1999, with about 10 active communities. It presells about 85% of homes, expected about 530 closings and $430M revenue in 2026 (HousingWire, Sept 2026), and develops its own land, notably the 800-plus-acre, 2,300-home Everlee master plan in Hoover.
